column1: # zoom-summary glossary TEMPLATE
# This file ships with the skill and is version controlled, so it holds NO real
# terms: project vocabulary and personal names would be published with the repo.
# Write your own entries in ~/.config/zoom-skill/glossary.tsv instead. That file
# loads on top of this one and overrides it by pattern.
# Format (tab separated, one entry per line):
#   pattern <TAB> replacement <TAB> tier <TAB> note
#   tier = high  -> substituted automatically
#   tier = low   -> never substituted, only reported under "검토 필요".
#                   Put "?" in the replacement column when the right term is
#                   unknown, or your best guess to have it shown as a suggestion.
# Matching: an all-ASCII pattern matches only when it is not flanked by other
# ASCII letters or digits, so "ABC" matches inside "ABC를" but not inside
# "XABCY". A pattern containing non-ASCII characters matches as a plain
# substring. Longer patterns are applied first.
# Promotion rule: an entry earns 'high' only with the user's explicit
# confirmation, or a citable line in the research log
# (~/.research/projects/<slug>/compass.md or journal.md). Put that evidence in
# the note column so the decision stays auditable. Plausibility alone is not
# enough: a wrong 'high' entry silently rewrites meeting records.
# Example rows, commented out so they never apply:
# ABC
# 어떤용어
